title: The dinosaurs ignored a tiny competitor

lines.tts: [intrigued] The dinosaurs ignored a tiny competitor. Biggest mistake ever.
lines.text: The dinosaurs ignored a tiny competitor. Biggest mistake ever.

lines.tts: Rex ran the biggest business in the valley. Big food, for big customers.
lines.text: Rex ran the biggest business in the valley. Big food, for big customers.

lines.tts: [booming, smug] I am too big to fail.
lines.text: I am too big to fail.

lines.tts: Then a tiny mammal opened a night stall. Selling bugs.
lines.text: Then a tiny mammal opened a night stall. Selling bugs.

lines.tts: [laughing, booming] Bugs? At night? Tiny market!
Too small for a giant to care. So Mo had it all to himself.
lines.text: Too small for a giant to care. So Mo had it all to himself.

lines.tts: Every night he learned. Got faster. Got more customers.
lines.text: Every night he learned. Got faster. Got more customers.

lines.tts: Big food? Gone. Big customers? Starving.
lines.text: Big food? Gone. Big customers? Starving.

lines.tts: [building] And the only one who knew how to live on tiny... was Mo.
lines.text: And the only one who knew how to live on tiny... was Mo.

lines.tts: That's disruption. Start where the giants won't look.
lines.text: That's disruption. Start where the giants won't look.
